authorship: Original Bunny facial performances; native expression/viseme IDs, no copied animation files.

tickle-giggle.intent: Squirms and giggles as if tickled, then settles; face beats from the Bunny Pet set

happy-hop.intent: Bouncy little hops with arms up and flapping ears; face beats from the Bunny Pet set

lonely-mope.intent: Head hung, shoulders slumped, ears drooping and a slow sigh; face beats from the Bunny Pet set

notepad-scribble.intent: Both hands up holding a notepad while one hand scribbles; add a notepad prop between the hands; face beats from the Bunny Pet set

paint-dabs.intent: Palette hand steady, brush hand dabbing at an easel to the side; face beats from the Bunny Pet set

snack-munch.intent: One hand rises to the mouth for a bite, twice, while watching something; face beats from the Bunny Pet set

robot-dance.intent: Stiff snapping poses on the beat with a deadpan face; face beats from the Bunny Pet set

skip-in-place.intent: A happy skipping stride with ear flops, one foot always down.

fall-flail.intent: Arms and legs flail as he drops; pair with a downward Move Y; face beats from the Bunny Pet set

land-squash.intent: A hard landing: squash down, rebound and a dizzy wobble; face beats from the Bunny Pet set

hang-on.intent: Chin over a ledge, hands gripping it, legs kicking below; face beats from the Bunny Pet set

climb-up.intent: Knee up, push, knee up, push: hauling himself over a ledge; face beats from the Bunny Pet set

hold-up-screen.intent: One arm stretched out to the side, gripping the edge of a screen, sign or video; face beats from the Bunny Pet set

naruto-run.intent: A true side-view sprint: fast low strides, arms swept straight back, ears streaming.

prance-twirl.intent: Happy prancing steps with a full 360 twirl.

turn-around.intent: A quick full-body turn through the front with a little hop

hang-one-hand.intent: Seen from behind: one hand catches an edge, then the second hand grabs on.

climb-struggle.intent: Seen from behind, both hands planted on the edge: elbows bend and press as the legs kick him up.

reading-stroll.intent: A side-view stroll with his nose in a book held up in both hands, the odd smile at a good line.

dance-twirl.intent: A squat, then a full 360 spin with arms out at shoulder height.

dance-disco.intent: Point up, point down, squat on the beat.

dance-wiggle.intent: Seen from behind: hip shake, ear wiggle and squats, side to side.

swing-up.intent: Seen from behind, hanging from one hand: legs pump to build a swing before he flips up onto the ledge.

phone-texting.intent: Standing with a phone in both hands, thumbs going.

texting-walk.intent: A side-view walk while texting: phone up in both hands, a giggle, then a cheeky reply.

drowsy-nod.intent: Sitting: a big yawn, the head droops slowly, then jerks awake.

dance-bounce.intent: Knee-bend bounces on the beat with a little turn each way.

dance-step.intent: Side steps with claps and squats, feet always on the ground.

cry-sob.intent: Head bowed, ears drooping, hands clutched at the chest while the shoulders heave with each sob.

angry-stomp.intent: Fists down, two heavy foot stomps in a three-quarter view, the body squashing into each landing.

panic-flail.intent: Arms flapping at shoulder height, hopping on the spot, head darting side to side, ears streaming back.

jaw-drop.intent: A tiny lean in, then a jolting hop back with arms flung wide and ears blown back; frozen in disbelief.

embarrassed-turn.intent: Ducks and turns three-quarters away, hands knotted at the chest, sneaks one peek back and hides again.

proud-puff.intent: A breath in, then chest out, chin up and fists on hips, with a satisfied little head tilt.

love-struck.intent: Hands held in at the chest, swaying dreamily side to side with soft floating ears.

point-at-you.intent: Winds back and jabs a foreshortened finger-hand straight at the viewer, twice.

eye-roll.intent: Chin lifts, the head rolls with the eyes from one side to the other, then the shoulders drop in a flat sigh.

suspicious-lean.intent: Hands tucked behind the back, a slow lean in with a narrowed side-eye and ears tipped forward.

nervous-laugh.intent: A forced smile and tiny giggle bounces while the hands fidget at the chest and the eyes dart away.

mind-blown.intent: Hands fly up to the sides of the face, then burst outward as he pops off the ground; slow head shakes of disbelief.

nope-wag.intent: Hand raised at shoulder height, wagging side to side with a head shake: nope, not happening.

reach-for-viewer.intent: Leans in and stretches both hands out toward the lens, grabbing at the viewer.

stop-palm.intent: Leans back and shoves one big foreshortened hand at the lens: stop right there.

knock-on-screen.intent: Knocks twice on the glass between him and the viewer, then tilts his head: hello, anyone there? Needs FOV about 55.

boop-lean-in.intent: Hands behind the back, he leans right into the lens so his face swells, then bounces back with a laugh.

fisheye-peek.intent: Pops in tilted from the side with a fisheye-bulged face, inspects the viewer up close and pulls back.

selfie.intent: One arm stretched up toward the lens as if it holds the camera; three quick selfie faces: grin, smug, wink.

shake-the-camera.intent: Both hands grab the edges of the lens and shake it: wake up! Needs FOV about 60.

trophy-win.intent: A crouch, a leap with the trophy thrust up high and out, a happy bounce and a proud pose.

shiver.intent: Arms hugged in tight, ears drooping, the whole body trembling in quick small shivers.

hide-and-peek.intent: Ducks down into a tight crouch, rises to peek left and right, then ducks again.

faint.intent: Wobbles dizzily, knees give way and he keels over sideways onto the floor, out cold.

tired-trudge.intent: Bent over with a hanging head and drooping ears, arms dangling, feet dragging in short steps.

cocky-strut.intent: Chest out, chin up, big arm swings and a bounce in every step, head bobbing to his own beat.

big-jump.intent: A deep squat, an explosive jump with arms up and knees tucked, then a heavy squash landing and recovery.

dodge-duck.intent: Ducks fast under something flying past, ears flattened, then leans out to check and sighs with relief.

tug-rope.intent: Leaning way back with heels dug in, hauling on a rope in heaves; the rope runs off-screen.

sword-slash.intent: Raises the sword back high, then cuts down and across with a lunge and holds the follow-through.

idea-lightbulb.intent: Thinking with a hand at his chin, then a jolt: he springs up, points and a lightbulb pops on above his head.

this-big.intent: Shows something tiny with the hands held close, then flings them out wide: it was THIS big!.

drumroll.intent: Hands patting fast and alternating on an invisible drum in front of him, leaning in, building suspense.

ta-da.intent: Little crouch, then a pop up with arms flung wide and jazz-hand wrist flutters: ta-da!.

beckon.intent: Leans back with a sly head tilt and curls the hand in twice: come here.

whisper-aside.intent: Turns aside, leans in and lifts a hand beside the mouth to share a secret; the hand stays in front of the face.

back-away.intent: Facing the threat three-quarters on, hands up defensively, careful steps backwards.

scream.intent: A sharp intake, then a full-body scream: chest up, arms flung out, ears pinned back, head shaking.

candle-story.intent: Holding a candle in its ring holder at the chest, he leans into a slow ominous telling with a sly smile.

sneak-side.intent: Three-quarter side view, hunched with paws up, lifting each foot high and setting it down toe first.

scared-run.intent: A frantic side-view sprint with arms flailing, ears streaming and wide eyes.

bunny-hop.intent: A springy side-view bunny hop: crouch, kick off, tuck in the air and land soft into the next.

trip-stumble.intent: Mid-step his foot catches, he pitches forward with arms thrown out, catches himself and plays it cool.

skid-stop.intent: Comes in at a run, leans way back with one foot braced forward to skid, ears flopping forward, and stops.

push-heavy.intent: Side view, leaning hard into a heavy crate with both arms locked, feet driving one after the other.

lift-heavy.intent: Squats, strains, and heaves a big box up to the chest; it wobbles left and right before he steadies it.

throw-ball.intent: Winds up with the arm far back, steps in and fires the ball straight at the lens, following through with the whole body.

punch-combo.intent: Fists up in guard, a jab and a cross thrown straight at the lens with foreshortened fists, then a bounce.

karate-chop.intent: Knees bend into a stance, the hand cocks up beside the shoulder and chops down at the lens with a shout.

weigh-options.intent: Palms up like a pair of scales, each hand rising in turn as he leans and looks toward it: this one, or that one?.

listen-closely.intent: Leans in close to the lens with a hand by his mouth for the juicy part, then straightens back up.

timeline-sweep.intent: One hand sweeps a timeline across the air from one side to the other while his body and eyes follow: first this, then that.

mic-drop.intent: A last line into the mic, arm swings out to the side and lets go; the mic clunks onto the floor at his feet as he looks away smugly.

show-phone.intent: Looks down at the phone, gasps, then thrusts it toward the viewer: look at this! The phone grows as it nears the lens.

magnify-inspect.intent: Holds a magnifying glass over one eye, which swells up behind the lens, sweeps it left and right, then finds something.

read-letter.intent: Holds a letter in both hands and reads it, then jolts back in shock at what it says.

umbrella-stroll.intent: Rests a short umbrella on his shoulder, the canopy tipped back behind his head, and sways contentedly.

look-over-shoulder.intent: Turned mostly away from the viewer, he slowly turns his head to glance over his shoulder, eyes widening at what is behind him.

disgust-recoil.intent: A curious sniff, then a sharp recoil: head turned away, hands up to fend it off, a shudder.

offer-gift.intent: Shyly turns the gift away, then holds it out toward the viewer with a big grin and heart eyes.

flashlight-scan.intent: Creeping torch sweep: shines a flashlight one way, swings it slowly past the camera to the other side, and jumps at a sound.

sip-coffee.intent: Raises the mug to his mouth for a slow sip, lowers it with a happy relieved sigh.

phone-call.intent: Phone pressed to the side of his head, chatting: listens, nods, gestures with the free hand and laughs.

rage-tremble.intent: Fists clenched low, the whole body shaking harder and harder, ears stiff, until a hot puff of steam blows off his head.

heartbreak-crumple.intent: A sharp gasp, both hands clutch his chest, then the knees give way and he sinks into a slow, sad slump with ears drooping.

gulp.intent: Freezes, eyes dart one way then the other, one big visible swallow, and he shrinks a little with a forced smile.

giddy-wiggle.intent: Can't contain it: fists tucked under his chin, he bounces on his toes while his shoulders wiggle and ears flap.

deflate-sigh.intent: A big breath in, then one long sigh out: shoulders, ears and head all sag together.

explain-hands.intent: Hands shape an invisible box in front of him, carry it over to one side, then move it across to the other.

raise-hand.intent: His hand shoots up and he bounces on his toes: me, me, I know this one!.

chin-think.intent: Hand at his chin, eyes up, a slow hmm with his head tilting side to side as he rubs it.

wipe-lens.intent: Leans in and fogs up the glass with a big breath, then wipes it clean in little circles and smiles at the result.

grab-viewer.intent: Lunges and grabs both edges of the frame, then hauls it toward himself so his face fills the shot with a sly grin.

poke-lens.intent: Curious poke at the glass, flinches back when it touches, then sneaks in and pokes it again, twice.

wave-bye-close.intent: Walks right up to the lens until his face fills the frame, then waves goodbye with a wink.

peek-from-below.intent: Rises slowly from the bottom edge, ears first, then his eyes.

popcorn-watch.intent: Munches popcorn from a tub, hand to mouth, then leans in wide-eyed at the good part.

hold-sign.intent: Lifts a blank placard up in front of his chest, bobs it twice for emphasis, then tilts his head at the viewer.

crystal-ball.intent: Hands hover and circle around a crystal ball, which bulges whatever sits behind it, until a vision makes him jolt back.

snap-photo.intent: Raises a camera, squints, snaps with a flash, then lowers it to check the shot and grins.

ghost-float.intent: Arms out in front with limp wrists, feet dangling above the floor, bobbing gently and swaying in the air.

possessed-twitch.intent: Stands frozen and blank, then sharp, jerky twitches of the head and one arm snap in and out without warning.

door-creak-peek.intent: Hidden behind a door, he slowly leans his head out past the edge, sees something and snaps back out of sight.

jump-scare-back.intent: Something leaps at the camera: he jolts back off the floor with ears shot straight up and arms flung, lands trembling, and clutches himself.

moonwalk.intent: In profile, one heel up while the flat foot slides back, swapping in a smooth heel-toe glide.

look-back-run.intent: Sprints in profile and throws a scared glance back over his shoulder mid-stride.

ice-slip.intent: Feet skid out from under him and his arms windmill as he wobbles side to side, then he freezes in a wide stance and sighs with relief.

boxing-guard.intent: Fists up in guard, bouncing on his toes, bobbing and weaving side to side and ducking under a punch.

look-over-there.intent: Spots something, flings an arm out to point off to the side and turns his head to follow, jabbing twice, then looks back at the viewer.

count-123.intent: Three firm nods, each with a karate-style hand chop on the beat: one, two, three.

but-wait.intent: Walking along, he stops mid-step, raises a finger and turns to the viewer with a sly look: but wait, there is more.

curtain-reveal.intent: Reaches across his body and sweeps one arm wide like pulling back a curtain: and here it is!.

time-skip.intent: A hop and a full spin on the spot, landing in a new pose with hands on hips: cut to three hours later.

air-quotes.intent: Both hands pop up out to his sides and flick twice, with a sarcastic raised eyebrow.

wait-what.intent: Leans back with his head tilted away and a palm raised out to his side, blinking in disbelief: wait, what?.

open-book.intent: Reads an open book held toward himself, cover facing us, turns a page, and gasps at what he finds.

creepy-head-turn.intent: Stands side-on and perfectly still while only his head turns, very slowly, to stare at the camera, then tilts it, still blank-faced.

skateboard.intent: Both feet planted on the board in a relaxed crouch, arms out for balance, swaying gently as he rolls.

flex.intent: Puffs out his chest and pops both fists out to his sides in a double flex, shows off to each side, gives an extra squeeze and a wink.

catch-ball.intent: Tracks a big ball flying in from the side, catches it in both hands with a little bump, and holds it up happily.

wind-up-pitch.intent: Big baseball wind-up with the knee kicked high, steps in and fires the ball at the lens, then holds the follow-through.

smug-nod.intent: Chin up, eyes half shut, two slow nods of total self-satisfaction.

huff-turn.intent: Stamps a foot, swings his body away in a sulk, sneaks a look back, then turns away again.

shy-sway.intent: Twists side to side with his eyes down, scuffing one toe and then the other on the floor.

grumpy-pout.intent: Head low, arms stiff at his sides, ears drooping, with two little huffs.

cringe.intent: The whole body scrunches, head sinking down and ears pinned, then slowly unclenches.

joy-spin.intent: A full turn on the spot with his arms out, then a happy hop.

pfft-whatever.intent: Flicks a hand away and turns his head with a dismissive lean.

totally-agree.intent: Hard nods with both hands open toward the viewer.

side-eye.intent: Freezes, his eyes slide to one side, then his head slowly follows.

hmm-maybe.intent: Rocks his head one way and the other as he weighs it up, then decides.

hold-on.intent: Both hands out, taking small steps back and patting the air to slow you down.

come-closer.intent: Leans right in to the lens and checks both ways before sharing a secret.

stare-down.intent: Leans slowly toward the camera with narrowed eyes and holds the stare.

bonk-lens.intent: Walks up to the screen, bonks into it with a squash, and stumbles back dizzy.

lean-into-frame.intent: Leans in from the side to say something, then leans back out.

hear-a-noise.intent: Freezes mid-step, his ears prick up and his eyes dart around, then he slowly puts his foot down.

zombie-shuffle.intent: Arms stiff out in front, head lolling, dragging slow steps.

spine-chill.intent: One big shudder that ripples from his knees up to his ears, then a small shiver.

slow-turn-around.intent: Senses something behind him and turns, very slowly, to look.

hopscotch.intent: One-foot, one-foot, two-foot hops, then the same on the other foot.

side-shuffle.intent: Quick crab steps sideways on bent knees.

casual-stroll.intent: A relaxed side-on walk with swinging arms and a small head bob.

limp-walk.intent: One stiff leg he drags along, dipping each time his weight lands on it.

out-of-breath.intent: Runs in side-on, stops, turns to us and pants with his hands on his knees.

floss.intent: The floss: arms swing across his body one way while his hips swing the other.

chicken-dance.intent: Flapping elbows, knee dips and a tail wiggle.

running-man.intent: The classic running-man step on the spot.

happy-feet.intent: A rapid little tap dance, his feet flicking one after the other.

vibe-sway.intent: Eyes closed, swaying and bobbing to the beat.

warm-up-stretch.intent: Side lunges one way and the other, then arm swings, warming up for something big.

squats.intent: Three deep squats with his arms out in front, then a proud exhale.

side-kick.intent: Turns side-on, chambers the knee, snaps a high kick out and lands balanced.

dizzy-spin.intent: Spins fast twice, then wobbles about on unsteady feet trying to stand straight.

sneeze.intent: A few little gasps building up, then one huge sneeze that jolts his whole body.

dramatic-pause.intent: Freezes mid-gesture, then slowly turns his head to look straight at the camera.

plot-twist.intent: Looking away, then snaps his head to the camera with a shocked lean back.

sit-for-story.intent: Drops down into a cosy crouch with his hands on his knees and settles in to tell it.

moral-of-story.intent: Raises one hand like a wise teacher and gives two knowing nods.

big-reveal-spin.intent: A quick spin that ends in a ta-da pose.

excited-to-crushed.intent: Bounces with excitement, hears the news, freezes in shock and slowly deflates into sadness.

angry-to-calm.intent: Stomps and fumes with fists clenched, then takes one big breath in, lets it out and calms right down.

scared-to-brave.intent: Cowers and trembles, peeks around, then stands tall, plants his feet and gets ready to face it.

laugh-to-cry.intent: Laughing so hard he shakes, then the laughter tips over into tears.

nervous-to-proud.intent: Fidgets and scuffs his feet, then puffs out his chest and stands proud.

confused-to-eureka.intent: Tilts his head this way and that, puzzling it out, then it clicks and he leaps with a hand in the air.

denial-to-acceptance.intent: Shakes his head no, slower and slower, then sighs and gives in with two small nods.

jealous-huff.intent: Watches someone else get the attention, stamps a foot, turns his back and keeps sneaking jealous looks.

heartbreak.intent: Clutches his chest as his heart breaks, then sags at the knees with his ears drooping.

lovestruck.intent: Sways dreamily side to side, then his knees go weak and wobble.

nod-off-startle.intent: Gets drowsy and his head drops twice, jolts awake, checks if anyone saw, and acts normal.

panic-then-breathe.intent: Looks around wildly, runs on the spot in a panic, then stops, breathes in deep and lets it go.

trip-and-recover.intent: Walking along, trips, windmills his arms to stay up, catches himself and checks if anyone saw.

sneak-and-caught.intent: Tiptoes along side-on, freezes mid-step, slowly turns to camera and grins sheepishly.

awkward-wave-back.intent: Waves back eagerly, realises it was meant for someone else and turns it into a casual stretch.

tightrope.intent: Arms out, inching along an invisible tightrope, nearly falls one way then the other, and steadies.

mime-box.intent: Mime routine: palms flat on invisible walls, pushing each side, finding no way out.

tug-of-war.intent: Side-on, heaving on an invisible rope, gets yanked forward, digs in and wins.

try-to-lift.intent: Strains to lift something heavy and invisible, shaking with effort, then gives up and laughs it off.

victory-dance.intent: A jump with both arms up, a spin, alternating arm pumps and a final pose.

robot-pops.intent: Stiff, snappy robot moves: head clicks, arm pops and body ticks.

pirouette.intent: Rises onto his toes with arms raised, spins once on one foot and finishes with a bow.

rocket-launch.intent: Crouches down, rumbles and shakes as the countdown builds, then blasts up with his arms overhead.

salsa-step.intent: Salsa basic: forward and back steps with hip sways and arms up.

once-upon-a-time.intent: A sweeping open-arms start to a story, then leans in low to draw you close.

second-look.intent: Glances, looks away, then snaps back for a second look and leans in, not believing it.

on-one-hand.intent: Weighs two sides with a hand for each, then brings them together to land the point.

meanwhile.intent: Turns away and points off into the distance, then swings back and leans in with a knowing look.

build-suspense.intent: Hushes down low, glances both ways to stretch it out, then bursts up with the big reveal.
